paper.title_en: Asymptotic AEther Misalignment and Universal-Horizon Mechanics
paper.abstract_en: Universal horizons trap even arbitrarily fast signals, providing a test of black-hole thermodynamics in theories with a preferred time direction. In Einstein--aether theory, this direction is defined by a dynamical field, the aether, that can remain non-aligned relative to stationary time at infinity. In particular, for asymptotically anti-de Sitter black holes, it was so far impossible to recover a first law of black-hole mechanics when such asymptotic tilt of the aether is present. Here, we resolve this issue for an exact family of static, spherically symmetric solutions. Using the covariant phase-space formalism, we identify the asymptotic tilt and the decaying part of the aether field as a boundary source and its conjugate response. Allowing both to vary independently obstructs the definition of an energy that generates time translations. Fixing either quantity, or imposing a relation between them, restores such an energy, while externally varying the boundary data introduces work into the first law. The energies obtained by fixing the source or its response are related by a Legendre transformation. At the universal horizon, heat includes both the metric area contribution and an irreducible aether energy flux. The resulting balance separates work at infinity from horizon heat and explains why the physical temperature cannot generally be inferred from the coefficient of an area variation in the black-hole mass.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该文直接处理带有渐近以太倾斜的黑洞第一定律这一黑洞热力学核心难题，使用协变相空间形式并区分普适视界处的面积贡献与以太能量通量，理论深度与相关性高，摘要清晰，与重点主题高度相关，值得进一步阅读。
decision.title_zh: 渐近以太失配与普适视界力学
decision.abstract_zh: 普适视界甚至能捕获任意快的信号，这为在具有偏好时间方向的理论中检验黑洞热力学提供了途径。在爱因斯坦—以太理论中，该方向由一个动力学场即以太场定义，而以太场相对于无穷远处的稳态时间可以保持不对齐。特别地，对于渐近反德西特黑洞，当以太场存在这种渐近倾斜时，迄今不可能恢复黑洞力学的第一定律。在此，我们针对一个精确的静态、球对称解族解决了这一问题。使用协变相空间形式，我们将渐近倾斜和以太场的衰减部分识别为边界源及其共轭响应。允许二者独立变化会妨碍定义生成时间平移的能量。固定其中任一量，或对二者施加一个关系，可恢复这样的能量，而外部改变边界数据则把功引入第一定律。通过固定源或其响应所得到的能量之间由勒让德变换相联系。在普适视界处，热量既包括度规面积贡献，又包括一个不可约的以太能量通量。由此得到的平衡关系将无穷远处的功与视界热量分离开来，并解释了为何一般不能从黑洞质量中面积变分的系数推断出物理温度。
